title: A4L_BRIDGE Project and Antioxidants Research
summary: The A4L_BRIDGE project is funded by the European Union. The Multidisciplinary Digital Publishing Institute publishes the Antioxidants journal, which is associated with the Basel gene or protein. The A4L_BRIDGE project is likely related to research on antioxidants, given its funding source and the publication of the Antioxidants journal by the Multidisciplinary Digital Publishing Institute.
